module_summary: textshape.cpp is the text-layout helper for the font system (fntsys.cpp): UTF-8 next/put, zero-width marks, CJK/Thai/Lao line-break rules and Arabic/Persian shaping plus right-to-left reordering into static 1024-codepoint buffers; it is live because lng/fork ships Arabic.yml and Persian.yml. textures.h/textures.cpp are the PNG/JPG texture loader: the positional table of embedded default textures (internalDefault, mirrored by enum INTERNAL_TEXTURE), libpng decode from embedded blobs, theme .tar members, staged RAM copies (MMCE/BDM) or a streaming 4 KB file reader, JPG art decode with downscale, OPL Manager art-name aliases, abort-flag plumbing for the art worker thread, and debug-HUD timing counters. Game art enters through texDiscoverArt (all itemGetImage backends), theme pictures through texDiscoverLoad / texLoadInternal.

reusable_helpers.name: txtNext
reusable_helpers.what: decodes one UTF-8 character (code point + byte length, broken sequence = 1 byte)

reusable_helpers.name: txtPut
reusable_helpers.what: appends a code point as UTF-8 into a bounded buffer, -1 if it does not fit with the terminator

reusable_helpers.name: txtShape
reusable_helpers.what: Arabic/Persian presentation-form shaping and per-line RTL reorder for left-to-right drawing

reusable_helpers.name: texPngHeaderIsSmallT8
reusable_helpers.what: checks a PNG signature + IHDR (29 bytes) for size and 8-bit palette before decoding

reusable_helpers.name: texStageExternalFileIntoMemory
reusable_helpers.what: reads a whole open file into a heap buffer: lseek size + one read, else 32 KB chunked growth with abort checks and an 8 MB cap

reusable_helpers.name: texArtAlias
reusable_helpers.what: maps OPL Manager art names (_BG_00, _SCR_00, _SCR_01) to OPL names and back for paths in an ART folder

reusable_helpers.name: texIsJpg
reusable_helpers.what: JPEG magic check (FF D8 FF) on a memory buffer

findings.title: Worst-open latch (texDebugWorstOpen, gTexWorstOpen*) and gBgmInRead exist only for a finished art-open investigation
findings.problem: Every staged art open samples two ioman queue depths, gBgmInRead and clock() to keep a session-worst record (5 statics, a 13-line getter, ~40 lines of investigation narrative incl. a quoted user report). The comment says the measurement exists to decide whether an in-RAM art directory index is worth building; that index now exists (artindex.cpp, IX field in the same HUD line), so the question is closed. gBgmInRead's only reader is textures.cpp:933.
findings.fix: Delete gTexWorstOpen* and texDebugWorstOpen, the pendAtOpen/menuAtOpen/bgmAtOpen sampling and latch update in texLoadAll, the W field in the HUD format string, gBgmInRead (definition, two writes, extern) and the sound.h include. Cut the 528-565 narrative to one line describing O:<hit>/<miss> if that field is kept.
findings.benefit: ~70 source lines removed (35 latch+getter, ~12 sampling, 4 header, 4 gBgmInRead, ~17 comment); a few hundred bytes of .text/.data, two queue reads per staged open (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -rn texDebugWorstOpen|gTexWorstOpen over src/RiptOPL: textures.cpp:566-584,937-942, textures.h:234, guioverlay.cpp:194 only. git grep gBgmInRead: sound.h:46, bgm.cpp:76,240,276 (writes), textures.cpp:933 (only read). HUD is drawn by Overlays::drawArtHud (guioverlay.cpp:134-218) behind the runtime debug setting, so it is compiled in every build. artIndexDebug/artIndexFindPicture exist in src/gfx/artindex.cpp:45 and are used by textures.cpp:1345,1357,1431. INFERRED part: that the owner no longer needs the W field.

findings.title: Stale comments in textures.cpp contradict the code they describe (absence rule, SEEK_END ban, OE meaning)
findings.problem: The 31-line block before gTexStagedOpenNonEnoent says the absence check returns 1 unconditionally and should 'match master' if OE climbs, but texStagedOpenIsAbsence (586-610) already returns err==ENOENT plus FatFs 4/5/6 for mass*, and counts non-absence on every device, not 'non-MMCE'. The block at 661-667 says 'Do NOT size the file with lseek(SEEK_END) first' directly under the fast path (639-641) that does exactly that for non-MMCE devices. The header and HUD comments repeat the outdated OE meaning.
findings.fix: Delete 495-525 except one line stating what gTexStagedOpenNonEnoent counts; reduce 661-667 to 'MMCE cannot SEEK_END: grow the buffer while reading'; reword textures.h:222-223 and guioverlay.cpp:179-182 to the current rule.
findings.benefit: ~35 comment lines removed; no ELF change (MEASURED from cited ranges: 31 + 7 lines, minus ~3 replacement lines)
findings.evidence: Read textures.cpp:495-525 (claims 'the code returns 1 unconditionally'), 586-610 (isAbsence = err==ENOENT, mass* adds 4/5/6, counter increments when !isAbsence on any device), 632-659 (lseek SEEK_END fast path when !shortReadIsEof), 661-667 (says not to lseek SEEK_END). textures.h:222-223 and guioverlay.cpp:179-182 describe OE as 'errno != ENOENT on a non-MMCE device' and say the code still needs master's ENOENT rule.

findings.title: 12 gfx/ PNGs that no build embeds: Device_1..6, Device_all, no_Device, no_Rating, logo4..6
findings.problem: textures.cpp maps these textures to NULL or to a shared blob (Rating_0, logo3/2/1), and tools/assets.py PNG_ASSETS (46-57, plus the Korium additions at 163) does not list them, so the source PNGs are never bin2c'd. logo4/5/6 and no_Rating are byte-identical to logo3/2/1 and Rating_0 (cmp). No other file references the file names.
findings.fix: Delete the 12 PNG files from gfx/. Keep the table rows: their names are still theme lookup keys (misc/*.cfg use default=no_Rating).
findings.benefit: 29,792 bytes of tracked repo files removed (MEASURED: inventory/RiptOPL.tsv sizes); no ELF change
findings.evidence: Read tools/assets.py:46-60 and 159-180 (only PNG_ASSETS, Korium extras and ra_mark are embedded, sourced from gfx/<name>.png). Grep for Device_[1-6all].png, no_Device, logo4 over the whole repo: only textures.cpp. git grep no_Rating: only theme cfg default= keys and textures.cpp:243. cmp gfx/logo4.png logo3.png, logo5/logo2, logo6/logo1, no_Rating/Rating_0: identical. Sizes from inventory: 582+742+886+899+600+784+1016+676+1332+8569+7161+6545 = 29,792.

findings.problem: The block lists UP/DOWN/L1/L2/R1/R2 as unused, but L1_ICON and R1_ICON are live enum values at textures.h:121-122 (with L1_png/R1_png externs at textures.cpp:62,64). The remaining names (up/down/L2/R2) have no asset in gfx/ and no reference anywhere.

findings.title: achievements.cpp jsonPutUtf8 re-implements textshape txtPut
findings.problem: jsonPutUtf8 (21 lines) encodes a BMP code point as UTF-8 into a bounded buffer with the same fit rule as txtPut (at+n must leave room for the terminator); txtPut is always linked (src/gfx is in the main ELF) and handles 4-byte sequences too. The only difference is the failure value (unchanged at vs -1).
findings.fix: Delete jsonPutUtf8 and at its single call site (achievements.cpp:219) call txtPut, keeping at when it returns -1.
findings.benefit: ~18 lines net removed in the RetroAchievements build; ~100 bytes .text (INFERRED, small static function)
findings.evidence: grep jsonPutUtf8|txtPut( over repo: achievements.cpp:159 (def), :219 (only call); textshape.cpp:36 (def), :446; textshape.h:12; ripps2_text_cases.inc tests. Compared fit checks: jsonPutUtf8 'at + n >= size' vs txtPut 'at + n > size - 1' (equivalent). achievements.cpp is added only by RA overlays (brief section 3).

findings.title: Small leftovers in textures: unused ERR_MISSING_ALPHA, mutable maxSize, identity ternaries, dead (void)filePath
findings.problem: ERR_MISSING_ALPHA appears nowhere else in the repo. maxSize is a non-const static that is never written (only read at 369). (void)filePath silences an unused-parameter warning for a parameter used at line 600. '(result >= 0) ? 0 : result' in texDiscoverArt/texDiscoverLoad is the identity: every loader path returns 0 or a negative ERR_* code.
findings.fix: Delete ERR_MISSING_ALPHA and the (void)filePath line; make maxSize constexpr; return result directly at 1405, 1408 and 1437.
findings.benefit: 2 lines removed, 3 simplified; a few bytes (one load per texSizeValidate call) (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -rn ERR_MISSING_ALPHA over the whole repo: only textures.h:200. grep maxSize in textures.cpp: 145 (def), 369 (read). Return values: texReadData returns 0 or ERR_*; texLoadAll returns texEnd(..., status) with those; texLoadJpgMemory returns 0 or ERR_*; texLoadJpgFile/texLoadArtFile/texFindArt pass them through.
